_comment: Rock relief of the continent footprint (docs/relief.md). Every number is here; loaded once at startup. Metres = blocks.
_mode_note: relief = ramp + summit cap (this prompt); plateau = the flat table of prompt 05 at plateau_height (for comparison and regression)
_ramp_note: ramp(d) = asymptote * (1 - exp(-slope * d / asymptote)), d = metres inland from the coast (exact distance to the sand, see distance). Slope at the coast = slope; it eases off towards the asymptote
_distance_note: the coast field has creases deeper inside thin ellipses, so the ramp uses an exact distance transform of the rock/sand outline on an 8 m lattice, one 256 m tile at a time (cached per world); distances are clamped at 700 m (ramp(700) is then about 112 m)
_soft_note: R = smoothmin(ramp, summit cap) with this blend width in metres, so the crease where the cap takes over is rounded

summit._spline_note: summit noise value (-1..1) -> summit cap in metres above the sand; monotone cubic through these points

_detail_note: fine surface noise; it fades to zero over the first fade_inland metres so the coast stays at sand level
